# Velocity components

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-components-ref.mjs from component-registry.json and the component sources. Do not edit by hand. -->

This file lists every component Velocity ships. Read it before reading component source or building a new component: reuse what exists here.

- **Check the import path exists in this project.** Projects can be scaffolded with only some components, so a component listed here may not be installed.
- **Missing components can be restored.** Follow "Restore a Velocity component" in the `velocity-add-component` skill: it downloads the files listed under **Files** for the version in `.velocity.json`, along with their dependencies. The CLI has no separate restore command; a fresh scaffold with the component selected also includes it.
- **Import by file path**, as in the examples. Category barrels such as `ui/index.ts` are removed from partial installs.
- Every `.astro` component accepts `class`, merged with `cn()`. Restyle with a wrapper in `src/components/patterns/` instead of editing a shipped file.
- Examples use literal text to stay short. In real pages, pass copy from `t()` (see `.agents/velocity.md`).

## Button

Button or button-styled link with variants (brand, primary, secondary, outline, ghost, link, destructive), sizes, loading state and optional leading/trailing icons. With unstyled it drops its own look and takes yours from class.

- **Import:** `import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';`
- **React island:** `import { Button } from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button';`
- **Registry id:** `button` · **Category:** UI Components / Form
- **Uses:** Icon
- **Files:** `src/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro`, `src/components/ui/form/Button/Button.tsx`, `src/components/ui/form/Button/button.variants.ts`, `src/components/ui/form/Button/index.ts`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `variant` | `'brand' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' \| 'link' \| 'destructive'` | `'primary'` |  |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |  |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` |  | Drop Button's own look (colour, size, radius, weight, hover) and style it entirely with `class`. It stays a Button: link handling, loading, icons, the focus ring and the disabled state all still apply. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |  |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` |  |  |
| `href` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `target` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `icon` | `boolean` | `false` |  |  |
| `leadingIcon` | `string` |  |  | Icon name shown before the label |
| `trailingIcon` | `string` |  |  | Icon name shown after the label |

Also accepts: `HTMLAttributes<'button'>`.

**Slots:** `default`

### Variants

CVA definitions from `button.variants.ts`.

`buttonVariants`:

| Variant | Options | Default |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `variant` | `brand`, `primary`, `secondary`, `outline`, `ghost`, `link`, `destructive` | `primary` |
| `size` | `sm`, `md`, `lg` | `md` |
| `fullWidth` | `true` |  |
| `icon` | `true` |  |

### Example

```astro
---
import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';
---

<Button variant="brand" size="lg" trailingIcon="arrow-right" href="/contact">Get in touch</Button>
<Button variant="outline" type="submit" loading>Saving</Button>
```

### Use instead

- Use Button with href for links styled as buttons, not a styled `<a>`; external URLs get target="_blank" and rel automatically.
- Use icon (with size) for square icon-only buttons, and give them an aria-label.
- Use the link variant for inline text actions, not a plain `<button>` with custom classes.
- Use variant="brand" for the main action in the brand colour (its text uses --brand-ink, so it passes contrast) instead of custom bg-brand classes; restyle tones in a wrapper, not by editing Button.
- Use unstyled for a button with its own look (an icon tile, a chip, a swatch) and style it with class, instead of a raw `<button>`: it keeps Button's link handling, focus ring and disabled state.

## Input

Text input with built-in label, hint, error message and optional leading/trailing icons.

- **Import:** `import Input from '@/components/ui/form/Input/Input.astro';`
- **React island:** `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/form/Input/Input';`
- **Registry id:** `input` · **Category:** UI Components / Form
- **Uses:** Icon
- **Files:** `src/components/ui/form/Input/Input.astro`, `src/components/ui/form/Input/Input.tsx`, `src/components/ui/form/Input/input.variants.ts`, `src/components/ui/form/Input/index.ts`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `label` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  |  |
| `leadingIcon` | `string` |  |  | Icon name to display at the start of the input |
| `trailingIcon` | `string` |  |  | Icon name to display at the end of the input |

Also accepts: `HTMLAttributes<'input'>`.

### Variants

CVA definitions from `input.variants.ts`.

`inputVariants`:

| Variant | Options | Default |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `size` | `sm`, `md`, `lg` | `md` |

### Example

```astro
---
import Input from '@/components/ui/form/Input/Input.astro';
---

<Input name="email" type="email" label="Email" hint="We never share it." leadingIcon="mail" required />
```

### Use instead

- Use Input with label/hint/error instead of wrapping it in FormField; it already wires ids and aria-describedby.
- Use PasswordInput for passwords and SearchInput for search fields.

Types:

### Variants

CVA definitions from `select.variants.ts`.

`selectVariants`:

```astro
---
import Select from '@/components/ui/form/Select/Select.astro';
---

```

### Use instead

- Use Dropdown for a menu of actions or links; Select is for choosing a form value.

## ToggleGroup

A segmented control (one choice from a few, e.g. Monthly / Yearly) built from native radio inputs: works without JavaScript and submits with a form. An option can be disabled or carry its own attributes; inputAttrs go to every input.

- **Import:** `import ToggleGroup from '@/components/ui/form/ToggleGroup/ToggleGroup.astro';`
- **Registry id:** `toggle-group` · **Category:** UI Components / Form
- **Uses:** Icon
- **Files:** `src/components/ui/form/ToggleGroup/ToggleGroup.astro`, `src/components/ui/form/ToggleGroup/index.ts`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `name` | `string` |  | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | yes | Names the group for screen readers |
| `options` | `Option[]` |  | yes |  |
| `value` | `string` | `options[0]?.value` |  | The option selected to start |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` |  |  |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` |  | Stretch to the container's width |
| `inputAttrs` | `Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| undefined>` |  |  | Extra attributes for every input, such as form or required |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |  |

Types:

```ts
interface Option {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  /** A Lucide icon name */
  icon?: string;
  /** Show only the icon; the label becomes its accessible name */
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  /** Show the option but don't let it be chosen */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Extra attributes for this option's input, such as data-* */
  attrs?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | undefined>;
}
```

### Example

```astro
---
import ToggleGroup from '@/components/ui/form/ToggleGroup/ToggleGroup.astro';
---

<ToggleGroup
  name="billing"
  label="Billing period"
  value="monthly"
  options={[{ value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' }, { value: 'yearly', label: 'Yearly' }]}
/>
```

### Use instead

- Use ToggleGroup for a short set of mutually exclusive options instead of hand-built segmented buttons; use Tabs when each option shows different content.

## Table

Responsive data table rendered from columns and rows arrays, with hover, striped and compact options, a caption for screen readers, row headers and icon cells.

- **Import:** `import Table from '@/components/ui/data-display/Table/Table.astro';`
- **React island:** `import { Table } from '@/components/ui/data-display/Table/Table';`
- **Registry id:** `table` · **Category:** UI Components / Data Display

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `columns` | `Column[]` |  | yes |  |
| `rows` | `Record<string, unknown>[]` |  | yes | Each value is text, a number or a Cell |

```astro
import Table from '@/components/ui/data-display/Table/Table.astro';

    { key: 'pro', label: 'Pro', align: 'center' },
  ]}
  rows={[

```

### Use instead

- A cell is text, or { icon, label } for an icon read as its label (a check for "Included"), or { text, class }. For anything richer write a `<table>` with the same semantic classes.

```astro
<Dialog id="delete-dialog" title="Delete project?" description="This can't be undone." size="sm">

  <div slot="footer" class="flex justify-end gap-3">
    <Button variant="outline" data-dialog-close>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="destructive" data-dialog-close>Delete</Button>
  </div>
</Dialog>

<script>
  const w = window as Window & { openDialog?: (id: string) => void };
  document.getElementById('delete-trigger')?.addEventListener('click', () => w.openDialog?.('delete-dialog'));
</script>
```

### Use instead

- Inline onclick is blocked by the CSP: open dialogs from a bundled `<script>` calling window.openDialog(id). Elements with data-dialog-close inside the dialog close it.
- Use Tooltip for hints and Alert for in-page messages; reserve Dialog for tasks that need focus.

## Sheet

A panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom (filters, cart, menu), on the native `<dialog>`: focus stays inside and Escape closes it. Opened by any button with data-sheet-open.

- **Import:** `import Sheet from '@/components/ui/overlay/Sheet/Sheet.astro';`
- **Registry id:** `sheet` · **Category:** UI Components / Overlay
- **Uses:** Icon
- **Files:** `src/components/ui/overlay/Sheet/Sheet.astro`, `src/components/ui/overlay/Sheet/index.ts`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|

| `description` | `string` |  |  |  |

```astro
import Sheet from '@/components/ui/overlay/Sheet/Sheet.astro';

<Sheet id="filters" title="Filters" side="right">
```

## Icon

Inline SVG icon: any Lucide icon by its kebab-case name (lucide.dev/icons), drawn at build time, plus a few brand marks, sized by preset.

- **Import:** `import Icon from '@/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon.astro';`
- **React island:** `import { Icon } from '@/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon';`
- **Registry id:** `icon` · **Category:** UI Components / Primitives
- **Files:** `src/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon.astro`, `src/components/ui/primitives/Icon/index.ts`, `src/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon.tsx`, `src/components/ui/primitives/Icon/brand-icons.ts`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `name` | `IconName \| (string & {})` |  | yes | A Lucide icon name, e.g. "map-pin", or a brand mark |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | `'md'` |  |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | `2` |  |  |

Types:

```ts
type IconName = LucideIconName | BrandIconName;
```

### Icon names

Any Lucide icon by its kebab-case name, aliases included: https://lucide.dev/icons. Don't draw your own SVG or add another icon set. Brand marks Lucide doesn't ship: `github`, `twitter`, `linkedin`, `brand-astro`, `brand-tailwind`, `brand-typescript`, `brand-react`. An unknown name renders the `x` icon and warns during the build.

### Example

```astro
---
import Icon from '@/components/ui/primitives/Icon/Icon.astro';
---

<Icon name="calendar-check" size="sm" class="text-primary" />
```

### Use instead

- Use the leadingIcon/trailingIcon props of Button and Input instead of placing Icon inside them by hand.
- Use any Lucide icon by name (https://lucide.dev/icons). Do not hand-draw SVGs, copy icon paths into a wrapper, or add another icon set.
- In a React island that needs the icon in its server HTML, import it from lucide-react by name (import { MapPin } from "lucide-react").

## Hero

Page-opening hero section, centered or split, with badge, title, description, actions and aside slots plus optional grid and blob backgrounds.

- **Registry id:** `hero` · **Category:** Hero

## Header

Site header with logo, nav from nav.config.ts, CTA, action buttons, theme toggle, language switcher and mobile menu; bar or floating capsule.

- **Import:** `import Header from '@/components/layout/Header.astro';`
- **Registry id:** `header` · **Category:** Layout Components
- **Uses:** Button, Icon, Logo
- **Files:** `src/components/layout/Header.astro`, `src/components/layout/header.variants.ts`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `layout` | `'default' \| 'centered' \| 'minimal'` | `'default'` |  | Layout style: default (logo left, nav right), centered (logo center), minimal (logo + cta only) |
| `position` | `'fixed' \| 'sticky' \| 'static'` | `'sticky'` |  | Position behavior |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  | Header height |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'solid' \| 'transparent'` | `'default'` |  | Background variant |
| `colorScheme` | `'default' \| 'invert'` | `'default'` |  | Color scheme for text/icons - use 'invert' for dark backgrounds |
| `shape` | `'bar' \| 'floating'` | `'bar'` |  | Shape: 'bar' (full-width, default) or 'floating' (centered capsule) |
| `breakpoint` | `'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | computed |  | Width at which the desktop nav replaces the mobile menu. Raise it for long or translated nav labels. Defaults to headerConfig.breakpoint, then 'md'. |
| `nav` | `NavItem[]` |  |  | Override default navigation (replaces getNavRoutes()) |
| `extraNav` | `NavItem[]` | `headerConfig.extraNav` |  | Additional navigation items (e.g., #features for landing pages) |
| `showCta` | `boolean` | `false` |  | Show CTA button |
| `cta` | `{ label?: string; href?: string }` | `headerConfig.cta` |  | CTA button configuration |
| `actions` | `HeaderAction[]` | `headerConfig.actions` |  | Action buttons (GitHub, etc.) |
| `showThemeToggle` | `boolean` | `true` |  | Show theme toggle (default: true) |
| `showMobileMenu` | `boolean` | `true` |  | Show mobile menu (default: true) |
| `showActiveState` | `boolean` | `true` |  | Show active state for current page (default: true) |
| `logoText` | `string` |  |  | Logo text override |
| `hideLogo` | `boolean` | `false` |  | Hide logo entirely |
| `showLanguageSwitcher` | `boolean` | `isMultilingual` |  | Show language switcher (default: when more than one locale is enabled) |
| `alternates` | `{ locale: Locale; href: string }[]` |  |  | Translations of this page, for the language switcher |

Also accepts: `HTMLAttributes<'header'>`.

Types:

```ts
interface NavItem {
  /** Translation key or plain text */
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}
interface HeaderAction {
  icon: string;
  href: string;
  label: string;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  target?: string;
}
```

**Slots:** `logo`, `nav`, `actions`, `mobile-menu`

### Variants

CVA definitions from `header.variants.ts`.

`headerVariants`:

| Variant | Options | Default |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `position` | `fixed`, `sticky`, `static` | `sticky` |
| `variant` | `default`, `solid`, `transparent` | `default` |
| `shape` | `bar`, `floating` | `bar` |

`headerInnerVariants`:

| Variant | Options | Default |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `size` | `sm`, `md`, `lg` | `md` |
| `shape` | `bar`, `floating` | `bar` |

### Example

```astro
---
import Header from '@/components/layout/Header.astro';
---

<!-- In src/components/site/SiteHeader.astro -->
<Header position="fixed" size="lg" shape="floating" showCta {...Astro.props} />
```

### Use instead

- Use SiteHeader (src/components/site/SiteHeader.astro), which every layout renders; set defaults there instead of rendering Header from a layout or page.
- Change nav items, CTA and actions in src/config/nav.config.ts.

- Use tone="invert" or tone="brand" for contrast bands; text and buttons inside recolour automatically.

## PageHero

Opening band for inner pages: the page's only `<h1>`, eyebrow, lead, tone, size, and slots for breadcrumbs, content after the title and a wide-screen aside.

- **Import:** `import PageHero from '@/components/blocks/PageHero.astro';`
- **Registry id:** `page-hero` · **Category:** Sections
- **Uses:** Band
- **Files:** `src/components/blocks/PageHero.astro`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `title` | `string` |  | yes |  |
| `eyebrow` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `lead` | `string` |  |  |  |
| `tone` | `BandTone` | `'secondary'` |  |  |
| `width` | `BandWidth` | `'default'` |  |  |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` |  | lg for pages that open with a statement (About, a landing page) |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |  |

**Slots:** `breadcrumbs`, `default`, `aside`

### Example

```astro
---
import PageHero from '@/components/blocks/PageHero.astro';
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/seo/Breadcrumbs.astro';
import Button from '@/components/ui/form/Button/Button.astro';
---

<PageHero eyebrow="Services" title="Family medicine" lead="Care for every age, same-week appointments.">
  <Breadcrumbs slot="breadcrumbs" items={[{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Services' }]} />
  <Button variant="brand" size="lg" href="/book">Book a visit</Button>
</PageHero>
```

### Use instead

- Use PageHero for inner pages that need breadcrumbs, buttons, a search form or an image; PageHeader is the plain version. Don't add another `<h1>`.
- Put seo/Breadcrumbs in the breadcrumbs slot instead of building your own trail.

## CtaBand

- **Uses:** Band
- **Files:** `src/components/blocks/CtaBand.astro`

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `title` | `string` |  | yes |  |
| `lead` | `string` |  |  |  |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Notes |
|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| `items` | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  | yes |  |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |  |

Types:

```ts
interface BreadcrumbItem {
  label: string;
  href?: string;
}
```

### Example

```astro
---
import Breadcrumbs from '@/components/seo/Breadcrumbs.astro';
---

<Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: 'Home', href: '/' }, { label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' }, { label: 'Hello world' }]} />
```

### Use instead

- Use Breadcrumbs for any page trail, e.g. in PageHero's breadcrumbs slot, instead of a hand-built list and hand-written BreadcrumbList data.
